comparison.objective: Move and seat a long strut across a keep-out without disturbing a housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual long-object handoff, obstacle clearance, and two-end seating.
comparison.success_condition: Both strut ends seated within tight pose tolerances, housing never exceeds disturbance limits, 1 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual load handling is generic; long-part obstacle traversal and seating do not test screening or media recovery.
